Title: Flesh of marble/King of the Mountain Query

Messages.Author: JonCooper
Messages.Body:
Have just been pondering the effect of a flesh of marble with king of
the mountain. If a vampire was wearing his flesh like marble and

does flesh of marble reduce the damge they take from King of the
mountain in other words?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <94793e38.01081...@posting.google.com>, JonCooper
<jon.c...@ntl.com> writes

>Ok LSJ, have another stoopid question...Can you put the card
>"Bloodhunt" (anyone can attack this vampire blah blah) on Muaziz? Only
>her card text says "cannot call bloodhunts on her" or something
>similar...whats the verdict?

Yes.

The "call" template refers to referendums. Since the Bloodhunt
permanent-rush action card isn't a referendum, it doesn't apply.
